# GENERATED by tools/regen_ef_monetary_policy.py -- do not edit by hand.
# EF.48, В4.1 (2.10): devaluation / revaluation as a CB tool with a target scale -- see the
# generator's docstring.
# !! MAINTENANCE !! Key-level REPLACE_OR_CREATE of E&F's three on_activate effects.

REPLACE_OR_CREATE:on_activate_law_no_monetary_policy = {
	zz_ef_mp_clear = yes
}
REPLACE_OR_CREATE:on_activate_law_revaluation = {
	remove_modifier = devaluation_currency_25
	remove_modifier = revaluation_currency_25
	add_modifier = {
		name = revaluation_currency_25
	}
	zz_ef_mp_init = yes
}
REPLACE_OR_CREATE:on_activate_law_devaluation = {
	remove_modifier = revaluation_currency_25
	remove_modifier = devaluation_currency_25
	add_modifier = {
		name = devaluation_currency_25
	}
	zz_ef_mp_init = yes
}

# The law came into force: start = target = today's cover. The AI arms it at once with its
# target (zz_ef_mp_ai_target); the player arms it by moving the target (scripted guis).
zz_ef_mp_init = {
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_cum value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_dyn value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_flow value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_pace } }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_pace value = zz_ef_mp_pace_default }
	}
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_start value = zz_ef_cb_cover }
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_target value = zz_ef_cb_cover }
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_prev value = zz_ef_cb_cover }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_armed }
		remove_variable = zz_ef_mp_armed
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_target value = zz_ef_mp_ai_target }
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_armed value = yes }
	}
}

# Back to no policy: our state and every E&F modifier of the 25/50/75 buttons go (the pace stays,
# it is the player's setting).
zz_ef_mp_clear = {
	remove_modifier = devaluation_currency_25
	remove_modifier = devaluation_currency_50
	remove_modifier = devaluation_currency_75
	remove_modifier = devaluation_currency_100
	remove_modifier = revaluation_currency_25
	remove_modifier = revaluation_currency_50
	remove_modifier = revaluation_currency_75
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_start } remove_variable = zz_ef_mp_start }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_target } remove_variable = zz_ef_mp_target }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_prev } remove_variable = zz_ef_mp_prev }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_dyn } remove_variable = zz_ef_mp_dyn }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_flow } remove_variable = zz_ef_mp_flow }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_cum } remove_variable = zz_ef_mp_cum }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_armed } remove_variable = zz_ef_mp_armed }
}

# The target reached: the parity becomes today's value (new metal content), the law ends.
zz_ef_mp_complete = {
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_parity_before value = var:money_value_target_1 }
	if = {
		limit = { money_value_0 > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = money_value_target_1 value = money_value_0 }
	}
	debug_log = "EFM|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|done|cover [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_cb_cover')|3]|target [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_mp_target_v')|3]|cum [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_mp_cum_v')|0]|parity_before [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('zz_ef_mp_parity_before').GetValue|4]|parity [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.Var('money_value_target_1').GetValue|4]"
	set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_cooldown value = yes days = 730 }
	activate_law = law_type:law_no_monetary_policy
	zz_ef_mp_clear = yes
}

# Monthly, from zz_ef_money_model_monthly_step.
zz_ef_mp_step = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_law = law_type:law_devaluation
				has_law = law_type:law_revaluation
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_target } }
			zz_ef_mp_init = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_flow value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { zz_ef_mp_can_work = yes }
			set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_dyn value = zz_ef_cb_cover }
			change_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_dyn subtract = var:zz_ef_mp_prev }
			set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_prev value = zz_ef_cb_cover }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_armed }
				if = {
					limit = { has_law = law_type:law_devaluation }
					if = {
						limit = { zz_ef_cb_cover <= var:zz_ef_mp_target }
						zz_ef_mp_complete = yes
					}
					else = {
						set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_flow value = zz_ef_mp_issue }
						add_treasury = var:zz_ef_mp_flow
						change_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_cum add = var:zz_ef_mp_flow }
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							OR = {
								zz_ef_cb_cover >= var:zz_ef_mp_target
								zz_ef_mp_withdraw_left <= 0
							}
						}
						zz_ef_mp_complete = yes
					}
					else = {
						set_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_flow value = zz_ef_mp_withdraw }
						change_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_cum add = var:zz_ef_mp_flow }
						add_treasury = {
							value = var:zz_ef_mp_flow
							multiply = -1
						}
						change_variable = { name = zz_ef_mp_flow multiply = -1 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_target }
			debug_log = "EFM|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|step|dev [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_mp_dir')|0]|armed [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_mp_armed_v')|0]|cover [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_cb_cover')|3]|start [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_mp_start_v')|3]|target [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_mp_target_v')|3]|flow [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_mp_flow_v')|0]|cum [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_mp_cum_v')|0]|m2 [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('money_supply')|0]|trea [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_treasury')|0]|ratio [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('zz_ef_mp_value_ratio')|3]"
		}
	}
	# the AI's rule (В4.1): it devalues an under-covered currency that has fallen, revalues an
	# over-covered one that has risen -- in both cases the parity follows the value
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			has_law = law_type:law_no_monetary_policy
			NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_cooldown }
			NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_isolationism }
			has_technology_researched = central_banking
			zz_ef_mp_can_work = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				zz_ef_cb_cover < zz_ef_mp_ai_dev_cover
				zz_ef_mp_value_ratio <= zz_ef_mp_ai_dev_ratio
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_devaluation
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_armed } }
				zz_ef_mp_init = yes
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				zz_ef_cb_cover > zz_ef_mp_ai_rev_cover
				zz_ef_mp_value_ratio >= zz_ef_mp_ai_rev_ratio
			}
			activate_law = law_type:law_revaluation
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zz_ef_mp_armed } }
				zz_ef_mp_init = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
